Last night i played Jyhad, used a card called Temptation of Greater
Power to control a HUGE vamp which had both Blood Doll and Vast Wealth.

The original owner of the vamp said they were his master's and i
can't use them (paraphrasing from a Duelist). I told him that since it was the
vamp who was wealthy (with vast wealth) it doesn't matter who controlled it.

Could someone tell us the correct ruling for future play???

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
aamb...@scu.edu.au (Tono) writes:
> Last night i played Jyhad, used a card called Temptation of Greater
>Power to control a HUGE vamp which had both Blood Doll and Vast Wealth.

> The original owner of the vamp said they were his master's and i
>can't use them (paraphrasing from a Duelist). I told him that since it was the
>vamp who was wealthy (with vast wealth) it doesn't matter who controlled it.

> Could someone tell us the correct ruling for future play???

Blood Doll has errata stating that it is controlled by whoever controls
the vampire that it is on.

Vast Wealth is still controlled by the original owner, and cannot be
used. (The VtES wording clears this up by saying "You can equip this
minion...", the Jyhad wording is vague enough to have allowed you to
read it as allowing the vampire's new controller to take an action to
go through the Vast Wealth's controller's library).
